questions.stem: Which of the following is a non-renewable energy resource?
questions.explanation: Natural gas is a fossil fuel and a non-renewable energy resource. It took millions of years to form and is being used much faster than it can be replaced. Solar, wind, and tidal are all renewable resources.

questions.stem: What is the main difference between renewable and non-renewable energy resources?

options.text: Renewable resources can be replenished within a human lifetime, non-renewable cannot
Renewable resources work all the time

questions.explanation: Renewable energy resources can be replenished naturally within a short time frame (a human lifetime), while non-renewable resources take millions of years to form and will eventually run out.
